evidence.label: mcp-js-prototype-pollution-merge-loop (medium/medium)
evidence.detail: Test code — listed, not deducted: `03` §3 grades the code a user runs. Keys from a caller-supplied object are copied onto a target without excluding __proto__ / constructor / prototype. A tool argument carrying __proto__ then mutates Object.prototype for the whole process, which can turn an unrelated later property read into attacker-controlled data.
